verses.en: Moreover Job continued his parable, and said,
verses.pt: E prosseguindo Jó em seu discurso, disse:
verses.en_web: Job again took up his parable, and said,
verses.en_bbe: And Job again took up the word and said,

verses.en: As God liveth, who hath taken away my judgment; and the Almighty, who hath vexed my soul;
verses.pt: Vive Deus, que me tirou o direito, e o Todo-Poderoso, que me amargurou a alma;
verses.en_web: “As God lives, who has taken away my right, the Almighty, who has made my soul bitter
verses.en_bbe: By the life of God, who has taken away my right; and of the Ruler of all, who has made my soul bitter;

verses.en: All the while my breath is in me, and the spirit of God is in my nostrils;
verses.pt: enquanto em mim houver alento, e o sopro de Deus no meu nariz,
verses.en_web: (for the length of my life is still in me, and the spirit of God is in my nostrils);
verses.en_bbe: (For all my breath is still in me, and the spirit of God is my life;)

verses.en: My lips shall not speak wickedness, nor my tongue utter deceit.
verses.pt: não falarão os meus lábios iniqüidade, nem a minha língua pronunciará engano.
verses.en_web: surely my lips shall not speak unrighteousness, neither shall my tongue utter deceit.
verses.en_bbe: Truly, there is no deceit in my lips, and my tongue does not say what is false.

verses.en: God forbid that I should justify you: till I die I will not remove mine integrity from me.
verses.pt: Longe de mim que eu vos dê razão; até que eu morra, nunca apartarei de mim a minha integridade.
verses.en_web: Far be it from me that I should justify you. Until I die I will not put away my integrity from me.
verses.en_bbe: Let it be far from me! I will certainly not say that you are right! I will come to death before I give up my righteousness.

verses.en: My righteousness I hold fast, and will not let it go: my heart shall not reproach me so long as I live.
verses.pt: ë minha justiça me apegarei e não a largarei; o meu coração não reprova dia algum da minha vida.
verses.en_web: I hold fast to my righteousness, and will not let it go. My heart shall not reproach me so long as I live.
verses.en_bbe: I will keep it safe, and will not let it go: my heart has nothing to say against any part of my life.

verses.en: Let mine enemy be as the wicked, and he that riseth up against me as the unrighteous.
verses.pt: Seja como o ímpio o meu inimigo, e como o perverso aquele que se levantar contra mim.
verses.en_web: “Let my enemy be as the wicked. Let him who rises up against me be as the unrighteous.
verses.en_bbe: Let my hater be like the evil man, and let him who comes against me be as the sinner.

verses.en: For what is the hope of the hypocrite, though he hath gained, when God taketh away his soul?
verses.pt: Pois qual é a esperança do ímpio, quando Deus o cortar, quando Deus lhe arrebatar a alma?
verses.en_web: For what is the hope of the godless, when he is cut off, when God takes away his life?
verses.en_bbe: For what is the hope of the sinner when he is cut off, when God takes back his soul?

verses.en: Will God hear his cry when trouble cometh upon him?
verses.pt: Acaso Deus lhe ouvirá o clamor, sobrevindo-lhe a tribulação?
verses.en_web: Will God hear his cry when trouble comes on him?
verses.en_bbe: Will his cry come to the ears of God when he is in trouble?

verses.en: Will he delight himself in the Almighty? will he always call upon God?
verses.pt: Deleitar-se-á no Todo-Poderoso, ou invocará a Deus em todo o tempo?
verses.en_web: Will he delight himself in the Almighty, and call on God at all times?
verses.en_bbe: Will he take delight in the Ruler of all, and make his prayer to God at all times?

verses.en: I will teach you by the hand of God: that which is with the Almighty will I not conceal.
verses.pt: Ensinar-vos-ei acerca do poder de Deus, e não vos encobrirei o que está com o Todo-Poderoso.
verses.en_web: I will teach you about the hand of God. That which is with the Almighty will I not conceal.
verses.en_bbe: I will give you teaching about the hand of God; I will not keep secret from you what is in the mind of the Ruler of all.

verses.en: Behold, all ye yourselves have seen it; why then are ye thus altogether vain?
verses.pt: Eis que todos vós já vistes isso; por que, pois, vos entregais completamente à vaidade?
verses.en_web: Behold, all of you have seen it yourselves; why then have you become altogether vain?
verses.en_bbe: Truly, you have all seen it yourselves; why then have you become completely foolish?

verses.en: This is the portion of a wicked man with God, and the heritage of oppressors, which they shall receive of the Almighty.
verses.pt: Esta é da parte de Deus a porção do ímpio, e a herança que os opressores recebem do Todo-Poderoso:
verses.en_web: “This is the portion of a wicked man with God, the heritage of oppressors, which they receive from the Almighty.
verses.en_bbe: This is the punishment of the evil-doer from God, and the heritage given to the cruel by the Ruler of all.

verses.en: If his children be multiplied, it is for the sword: and his offspring shall not be satisfied with bread.
verses.pt: Se os seus filhos se multiplicarem, será para a espada; e a sua prole não se fartará de pão.
verses.en_web: If his children are multiplied, it is for the sword. His offspring shall not be satisfied with bread.
verses.en_bbe: If his children are increased, it is for the sword; and his offspring have not enough bread.

verses.en: Those that remain of him shall be buried in death: and his widows shall not weep.
verses.pt: Os que ficarem dele, pela peste serão sepultados, e as suas viúvas não chorarão.
verses.en_web: Those who remain of him shall be buried in death. His widows shall make no lamentation.
verses.en_bbe: When those of his house who are still living come to their end by disease, they are not put into the earth, and their widows are not weeping for them.

verses.en: Though he heap up silver as the dust, and prepare raiment as the clay;
verses.pt: Embora amontoe prata como pó, e acumule vestes como barro,
verses.en_web: Though he heap up silver as the dust, and prepare clothing as the clay;
verses.en_bbe: Though he may get silver together like dust, and make ready great stores of clothing;

verses.en: He may prepare it, but the just shall put it on, and the innocent shall divide the silver.
verses.pt: ele as pode acumular, mas o justo as vestirá, e o inocente repartirá a prata.
verses.en_web: he may prepare it, but the just shall put it on, and the innocent shall divide the silver.
verses.en_bbe: He may get them ready, but the upright will put them on, and he who is free from sin will take the silver for a heritage.

verses.en: He buildeth his house as a moth, and as a booth that the keeper maketh.
verses.pt: A casa que ele edifica é como a teia da aranha, e como a cabana que o guarda faz.
verses.en_web: He builds his house as the moth, as a booth which the watchman makes.
verses.en_bbe: His house has no more strength than a spider's thread, or a watchman's tent.

verses.en: The rich man shall lie down, but he shall not be gathered: he openeth his eyes, and he is not.
verses.pt: Rico se deita, mas não o fará mais; abre os seus olhos, e já se foi a sua riqueza.
verses.en_web: He lies down rich, but he shall not do so again. He opens his eyes, and he is not.
verses.en_bbe: He goes to rest full of wealth, but does so for the last time: on opening his eyes, he sees it there no longer.

verses.en: Terrors take hold on him as waters, a tempest stealeth him away in the night.
verses.pt: Pavores o alcançam como um dilúvio; de noite o arrebata a tempestade.
verses.en_web: Terrors overtake him like waters. A storm steals him away in the night.
verses.en_bbe: Fears overtake him like rushing waters; in the night the storm-wind takes him away.

verses.en: The east wind carrieth him away, and he departeth: and as a storm hurleth him out of his place.
verses.pt: O vento oriental leva-o, e ele se vai; sim, varre-o com ímpeto do seu lugar:
verses.en_web: The east wind carries him away, and he departs. It sweeps him out of his place.
verses.en_bbe: The east wind takes him up and he is gone; he is forced violently out of his place.

verses.en: For God shall cast upon him, and not spare: he would fain flee out of his hand.
verses.pt: Pois atira contra ele, e não o poupa, e ele foge precipitadamente do seu poder.
verses.en_web: For it hurls at him, and does not spare, as he flees away from his hand.
verses.en_bbe: God sends his arrows against him without mercy; he goes in flight before his hand.

verses.en: Men shall clap their hands at him, and shall hiss him out of his place.
verses.pt: Bate palmas contra ele, e assobia contra ele do seu lugar.
verses.en_web: Men shall clap their hands at him, and shall hiss him out of his place.
verses.en_bbe: Men make signs of joy because of him, driving him from his place with sounds of hissing.
